environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 14 database on RDS with DB_USER='app_service' which has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all application tables including audit_log. Application logs written to /var/log/app/audit.log which is ingested by CloudWatch Logs agent and parsed by a SIEM that triggers alerts based on log content patterns. No input sanitization on user-supplied values before logging or SQL construction.

config.db_user_privileges: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
config.log_pipeline: CloudWatch Logs -> Lambda parser -> SecurityHub findings
config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB with no WAF
